readerCopy.body: Personal taste and desire can become easier to trust when outside approval temporarily matters less than actual fit. When Venus trines Lilith, connection and autonomy reinforce each other, making relationships, style, pleasure, money, and preference less dependent on what other people would choose. Acceptance of a preference can be useful information without proving compatibility everywhere else. The ease comes from letting the choice be specific instead of turning it into a referendum on respectability.
